## Scope check

slopshield is deliberately npm-first, heuristics-only, and dependency-free.
Out of scope for now: other ecosystems (pip/PyPI), IDE/agent hooks, a hosted
dashboard, and known-CVE/SCA coverage (that's Snyk/Dependabot's job).
